title: Oscilloquartz expands OSAinside™ Series OSA 5400 TimeCard™ with advanced server-integrated timing capabilities
summary: Oscilloquartz today announced significant new capabilities for its OSAinside™ Series OSA 5400 TimeCard™, expanding the flexibility and performance of server-integrated timing for defense, data center, telecom and finance applications.
body_markdown:
News summary:


- Enhanced OSA 5400 TimeCard™ brings high-performance synchronization directly into COTS and purpose-built servers
- Advanced capabilities include PCIe Precision Time Measurement, multi-band GNSS with NavIC and Galileo OSNMA, optional Iridium® PNT and flexible oscillator options
- OSA 5400 TimeCard™ and OSA 5400 TAP TimeCard™ options support flexible server-integrated timing architectures for defense, data center, telecom and finance applications


Oscilloquartz today announced significant new capabilities for its OSAinside™ Series OSA 5400 TimeCard™, expanding the flexibility and performance of server-integrated timing for defense, data center, telecom and finance applications. With support for multiple deployment architectures and timing sources, the enhanced OSA 5400 TimeCard™ enables organizations to integrate highly accurate synchronization directly into commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) and purpose-built servers, reducing reliance on dedicated external timing appliances. Available as the OSA 5400 TimeCard™ and the OSA 5400 TAP TimeCard™, the platform supports PCIe Precision Time Measurement (PTM), multi-band L1/L5 GNSS with NavIC and Galileo OSNMA, advanced jamming and spoofing detection and multiple oscillator options for precise server-level synchronization.
